races.paceDynamic: Touleen will lead from the gates with only Princess Petrol, Zooming, Figjam and Splish Splash showing prominent tendencies, creating a sustainable gallop rather than breakneck speed. The majority of this field comprises hold-up horses including quality runners like Catching The Moon, Sukanya, K Sarra and Domina Ignis, who will track the modest pace before unleashing late challenges. With one uncontested leader and a large pack of closers, the tempo will be steady early before exploding in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position just behind the leaders, as they'll have first run on the hold-up brigade when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Kicks
scenarios.trigger: If Touleen faces no early pressure and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The tempo stays manageable through halfway before Touleen finds another gear entering the straight. The hold-up horses get their chance but the leader's jump proves decisive against horses coming from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Win
scenarios.trigger: If Princess Petrol or Zooming track Touleen perfectly in second or third
scenarios.body: These tactically positioned runners get first run on the leader while the hold-up horses are still making ground from the rear. The race becomes about who positioned closest to the pace rather than pure finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle sections
scenarios.body: The closers get the perfect setup as Touleen stops quickly and the prominent horses also tire from the sustained effort. Class tells as the better hold-up horses sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Touleen early and create unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The early leaders burn each other out through aggressive positioning, leaving the race wide open for any hold-up horse with a finishing kick. The winner emerges from the back third of the field in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Touleen could steal this if she gets soft fractions early and none of the prominent horses pressure her through the middle sections
Princess Petrol has tactical speed to sit second and may prove too strong for Touleen when she challenges while getting first run on the closers
The hold-up horses including Catching The Moon and Sukanya need the pace to completely collapse to be effective from their preferred positions
Track Zooming's positioning early as she has the pace to sit prominent and strong course form suggests she handles Newbury's demands
Several runners including Zaravina and Stimulative Trip face significant layoffs that could blunt their finishing kicks regardless of race shape

races.paceDynamic: Aqpan will lead unopposed with the prominent racers (Gonna Fly, Albert Einstein, Alparslan, Title Role) settling just behind, creating a moderate tempo over this 7f trip. The hold-up horses (Zavateri, Needle Match, Ardisia) will be placed at the back, relying on the field stringing out in the straight. With only one confirmed leader and several prominent types not needing to force the issue, this sets up as a tactical affair where the pace may not be strong enough to fully expose the front end. This race shape favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid any early scrimmaging, with hold-up horses facing the risk of an insufficient pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows prominent horses to travel smoothly and time their challenges.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure lets Albert Einstein, Title Role and Alparslan conserve energy while staying ideally positioned. They can quicken together in the straight while Aqpan fades and the hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close into.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens more than expected in the middle sections, stringing out the field.
scenarios.body: A stronger tempo than anticipated will set up perfectly for Zavateri and Ardisia to unleash their finishing kicks. The prominent horses get caught between going too early or being swamped late by the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Aqpan gets an uncontested lead and the chasers are slow to organize.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Aqpan to dictate completely comfortable fractions before finding extra when challenged. The prominent horses hesitate too long while the hold-up brigade leave themselves too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate tempo becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of acceleration from the 2f marker with positioning crucial. This favours whoever has the most natural speed regardless of running style, potentially benefiting fresh horses or those with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Aqpan could steal this if the prominent horses are too patient and allow him completely uncontested fractions throughout.
Albert Einstein's last run was a disappointing 6th over 7f on heavy ground, watch for any signs of laboured action early.
Zavateri and Ardisia both return after long breaks exceeding 160 days, fitness could be a significant factor.
The prominent racers could get into a speed duel if none wants to let Aqpan dictate, which would set up the hold-up horses perfectly.
Title Role has the fitness edge having raced most recently and could benefit if this becomes tactical late.

races.paceDynamic: Convergent will set a controlled tempo from the front with Phantom Flight tracking prominently, creating a sustainable rhythm in this small field. The lack of natural pace pressure means the leaders can dictate terms through steady fractions, setting up a tactical finish rather than a stamina test. With five hold-up horses including Al Aasy, Lion's Pride and Bellum Justum all needing to make their moves late, traffic problems are inevitable in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can avoid the scramble and have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Convergent and Phantom Flight control the pace without pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders get an uncontested run and kick clear before the hold-up horses can organise their challenges. Traffic issues behind allow the front pair to exploit their positional advantage decisively.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The hold-up horses time their moves perfectly and overhaul the leaders with superior finishing speed. Ryan Moore's tactical expertise on Lion's Pride or Marquand's timing on Al Aasy proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tenability Stakes Claim
scenarios.trigger: If the Haggas runner gets a dream passage through the pack
scenarios.body: Despite the OR rating, Tenability's excellent recent form and strong going record allows him to exploit gaps that others miss. His three consecutive wins show he's capable of defying the ratings when things fall right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Favours
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get severely hampered in running
scenarios.body: The interference creates a messy finish where positioning trumps ability, allowing an outsider to sneak through. The small field creates a bottleneck that benefits whoever finds daylight first.

watchPoints.text: Convergent could get an uncontested lead given the lack of pace pressure and prove very hard to peg back

races.paceDynamic: Urban Lion will lead with Hand Of God, Stem, Whip Cracker, Samuel Colt, Old Cock, Jimmy Speaking, Hot Cash and Serengeti all showing prominent tendencies - creating a fast early gallop in this large field. The sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina over this mile trip on good ground. With so many hold-up horses including Checkandchallenge, Al Mubhir, Fifth Column, Ebt's Guard, Ozat, Nizam, Back In Black, Classic, Tony Montana, Linwood, Nikovo, Ancient Rome, Shout, Cogitate, Boyfriend, Rogue Diplomat and Oliver Show all needing to be delivered late, the strong pace will perfectly suit hold-up performers who can finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the numerous prominent runners create a genuinely strong pace from the start
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field and create perfect conditions for the many hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks. Quality closers like Fifth Column, Ebt's Guard, Checkandchallenge and Tony Montana will have ideal conditions to sweep up the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tactical success
scenarios.trigger: If one or two prominent horses can secure comfortable positions without over-racing
scenarios.body: Smart prominent performers like Whip Cracker or Stem can exploit their tactical speed while others go too fast early. Their positioning advantage allows them to quicken when the hold-up horses are still making ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late closer steals it
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly extreme with multiple speed horses going too hard
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to a patiently ridden hold-up horse who has been kept furthest back. Horses like Shout or Rogue Diplomat, both in good recent form, can capitalize on a complete pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Urban Lion can dictate terms without serious early pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The leader controls fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges in a moderate pace scenario. This requires the many prominent horses to settle rather than engage early.

watchPoints.text: Urban Lion must be monitored early - if he gets an uncontested lead the race dynamic completely changes

Track how aggressively the hold-up horses are positioned early - with so many closers, jockeys may ride more forward than usual

races.paceDynamic: Exclusive Code and Battosai will contest the early lead in this large 26-runner maiden field, creating an honest gallop from the outset. With limited pace beyond these two confirmed front runners, the tempo should be solid but not overly strong through the middle stages. The big field and relatively straightforward early pace sets up a staying test where horses need to finish strongly from off the tempo. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with tactical speed, as they can position behind the pace and unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Exclusive Code and Battosai creates an honest gallop without being overly strong
scenarios.body: The large field will bunch up turning for home, setting up a cavalry charge where horses with finishing kicks can weave through and strike late. Patient tactics and strong closing speed become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses mid-race with the two leaders going too slow
scenarios.body: Horses tracking in 3rd-6th positions can move up smoothly and dictate from 3f out, avoiding the traffic problems that will engulf those held up. Clean runs and tactical positioning prove crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Survive
scenarios.trigger: If both Exclusive Code and Battosai go steady early and save energy for a sustained drive
scenarios.body: One of the early leaders kicks clear in the straight while the field behind struggles to organize an effective challenge. The combination of controlled pace and class tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Shock Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy scramble with multiple pace angles failing
scenarios.body: A well-handicapped outsider with the right trip gets a dream run through gaps and outfinishes the fancied runners. Form lines prove unreliable in large maiden fields.

watchPoints.text: Exclusive Code and Battosai must both go forward early - if either misses the break or settles, it transforms the pace scenario completely

King Of Earth may be vulnerable if the pace collapses as his style requires something to aim at

races.paceDynamic: Twisting Physics provides the only confirmed early pace in this 16-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the front without serious pressure through the early stages. The prominent runners Rathgar, Jupiter Ammon, Morcar, and Sportingsilvermine will settle just behind, but none are aggressive early types to challenge for the lead. This sets up a controlled tempo that builds gradually, with the large field of hold-up horses including Valedictory, Bulletin, Triple Double A, and Marhaba The Champ needing the pace to develop sufficiently for their finishing kicks. The tactical profile strongly favours prominent runners who can track the moderate pace and have first run on the leaders, rather than hold-up horses who may find insufficient tempo to showcase their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Prominent Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Twisting Physics sets uncontested fractions and prominent trackers get first run
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows prominent runners to save energy while staying close enough to strike first. Hold-up horses find insufficient pace development to mount their customary late charges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack increases pressure on Twisting Physics from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates the pace collapse needed for closers. Late runners benefit from extra gallop and tired leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Twisting Physics gets completely uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to reserve energy for a decisive move. Prominent trackers left flat-footed by the sudden acceleration while closers have too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners challenge Twisting Physics too early
scenarios.body: The over-aggressive early pace sets up a war of attrition where stamina trumps class. Long-absent runners with fresh legs capitalize on the battlefield.

watchPoints.text: Twisting Physics getting completely uncontested lead could prove decisive given lack of pace pressure
Watch for early positioning of Jupiter Ammon and Rathgar as they represent the main prominent threats
Monitor how aggressively the hold-up horses are ridden if pace appears insufficient for their style
Baltic Voyage and Royale Goodnight both return from very long breaks with fitness questions
